item.title: Weekly Moment With the Rebbe
item.description: 1930. In the days of Prohibition and Depression, where liquor was scarce and money was scarcer, how did the Previous Rebbe uplift the “Jews without booze”? The Avner Institute presents the riveting first arrival of Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Schneersohn to America following his escape from Soviet prison and Stalin, the modern-day Amalek; and his warm welcome in Milwaukee, on 9 Adar, Full Story
